name: Glovis America Port Vehicle Processing - Newark/Elizabeth NJ

fieldNotes.siteSelection: Roster address 'E Bay Ave, Elizabeth NJ' geocoded to GEOMETRIC_CENTER and landed inside the APM/Maher CONTAINER terminal on the Elizabeth side - wrong building. Web research (Glovis America locations; Moran Shipping; Ports America) shows the Glovis Newark vehicle-processing operation is at the Port Newark Auto Terminal. Street View at the entrance carries a clear 'PORTS AMERICA - Port Newark Auto Terminal, 325 Distribution St, Newark, NJ 07114' sign. FAPS Inc. and Glovis process Hyundai/Kia vehicles at Port Newark's auto terminals. Relocated the locked center to the Port Newark Auto Terminal core at 40.6940,-74.1340.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Port RoRo vehicle import/export processing terminal on the Port Newark peninsula tip. No traditional loading docks - vehicles roll on/off ships at the wharf and move within the terminal by drive-away and rail. dockDoorCount=0 / dockDoors=NONE reflect this.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE - confirmed in Street View (2019-07): a sliding chain-link gate (with reflective markers) spans the truck entrance off Distribution St.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE - confirmed in Street View: a low windowed guard/terminal-office building sits immediately beside the gate at 325 Distribution St under the Ports America sign.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - rail tracks cross the access road at the gate ('DO NOT STOP ON TRACKS' sign) and multiple parallel tracks run along the terminal's north edge in satellite imagery; auto-rack rail service.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: TRUE - dense urban port environment; the gate sits at a rail-crossed intersection on Distribution St with limited stacking room, so a truck queue would foul the rail crossing / port road.
fieldNotes.multiStep: TRUE (best estimate, flagged uncertain) - secured port auto terminals typically run a gate check plus internal yard/processor checkpoints.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - the terminal is filled with tens of thousands of finished vehicles in densely packed marked rows across the peninsula.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - multiple large PDI/processing buildings plus terminal-office and wharf infrastructure on one terminal campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - the facility is inside the dense Port Newark/Elizabeth marine-terminal complex in the Newark metro core.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: False - this is a RoRo import/export terminal; vehicles flow through shared wharf and storage rather than separate shipping/receiving dock banks.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~270 acres for the secured auto-terminal perimeter (irregular peninsula footprint within the ~390-acre bounding box).
